correspondences.notes: BIDS has no head-MRI transform suffix; coordsystem.json records fiducials instead.

brainlife.desc: Head-to-MRI coordinate transform in MNE FIF (trans.fif) from MEG/EEG-MRI coregistration.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/trans
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Forward modelling: aligns sensor and MRI coordinates for one subject and session.

**Not for:** Other subjects or sessions with a different head position.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.trans.json

identifying_risks: Low: a single matrix, linkable only through the participant code.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative without identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with the subject's MEG and MRI derivatives under the same controls.
tier_conditions: Stays tier 2; no condition moves it.

inputs_of.name: Make Forward Solution
inputs_of.purpose: MEG/EEG forward solution from source space, transform and BEM

intended_use: Forward modelling: aligns sensor and MRI coordinates for one subject and session.
not_suitable_for: Other subjects or sessions with a different head position.

outputs_of.name: Automated  coregistration
outputs_of.purpose: head-MRI coregistration from digitisation points, giving trans.fif
